subject: general
question: If sec θ = 5x and tan θ = 5/x, then the value of 10(x² - 1/x²) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Secθ = 5x & tanθ = 5/x

**Concept used:**

Sec²θ - tan²θ = 1

**Calculations:**

Secθ = 5x

Sec²θ = 25x²

Tanθ = 5/x

Tan²θ = 25/x²

Now,

10[x² - (1/x²)] = 10[(sec²θ/25) - (tan²θ/25)]

⇒ (10/25) [sec²θ - tan²θ]

⇒ 10/25

⇒ 2/5

**∴ The correct choice will be option 1.**
